subject: prd/local-work-tracker
statement: When asked to list work items filtered by state and by signal (by name or by role), the tracker shall return the matching set, bounded and stably sorted, in a deterministic order (e.g. creation order).
rationale: the discovery primitive under readiness and triage; fair rotation needs a stable order (INV-12)
fit_criterion: a known corpus returns the exact expected set and order for each filter, including selection of the factory-implementable set by its routing/authorization signal (the local-agent analog)
